name: Barbell Jefferson Squat
steps: Straddle a barbell on the floor with your feet angled slightly out, one foot on each side of the bar.
Squat down with a tall chest and flat back, gripping the bar between your legs with one hand ahead and one behind.
Brace your core tightly and drive evenly through both feet to stand tall with the bar centered between your thighs.
Bend your hips and knees smoothly to lower the bar back to the floor under control.
tips: Track both knees in line with your angled toes throughout the lift.
Reverse your stance and hand placement when you next perform the lift.
